keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «얼굴과 두 손은 있지만 팔다리는 없는 것은 무엇일까?(문제)» 와 «진짜 보물은 친구와 함께한 모험이다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the riddle about something with a face and two hands) and the lesson (the real treasure is the adventure shared with a friend). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: They had to solve a pirate's riddle to find the treasure.
The real treasure is an adventure shared with a friend.

words: Answer my riddle, and my treasure is yours.
a question that is like a fun puzzle
The real treasure is the adventure you shared with a friend.
gold or other very valuable things
gave an answer without being sure
They walked through town, looking for clues.
small facts that help you find an answer
There, on the tower, was a big old clock!
the adventure you shared with a friend

qs.q: How did Leo suddenly find the answer to the riddle?
qs.qko: 레오는 어떻게 갑자기 수수께끼의 답을 알게 되었나요?
opts: He looked up and saw a big old clock on the tower.
He found the answer inside the bottle.
evs: "A monster?" Dana guessed. "A robot?" Leo said.
There, on the tower, was a big old clock!
Inside was a pirate's note: "Answer my riddle, and my treasure is yours."
Inside, there was no gold, only a letter.
why: 레오가 고개를 들어 탑 위의 커다란 낡은 시계를 보았어요. 시계에는 얼굴(문자판)과 두 손(바늘)이 있어서 답을 알게 되었어요. 다나가 답을 알려 줬다는 말은 없어요.
Leo looked up and saw a big old clock on the tower. A clock has a face and two hands, so he knew the answer. Dana did not tell him.

qs.q: The riddle says, "I have a face and two hands." What are the "hands" of a clock?
qs.qko: 수수께끼에 "I have a face and two hands."라고 나와요. 시계의 "hands"는 무엇인가요?
opts: the long and short pointers that show the time
the hands of a person who holds the clock
evs: Leo and Dana found an old bottle on the beach.
"A clock has a face and two hands!" he shouted.
Leo and Dana laughed, because it was true.
why: 레오가 «시계에는 얼굴과 두 손이 있다!» 라고 외쳤어요. 시계의 «손» 은 사람 손이 아니라 시간을 가리키는 바늘을 뜻해요.
Leo shouted, «A clock has a face and two hands!» A clock's hands are not real hands. They are the pointers that show the time.

qs.q: Why did Leo and Dana laugh at the end?
opts: There was no gold, but they agreed their adventure was the real treasure.
They found a box full of gold.
The pirate came back and told a joke.
evs: Inside, there was no gold, only a letter.
The letter said, "The real treasure is the adventure you shared with a friend."
They walked through town, looking for clues.
why: 상자 안에는 금이 없고 편지만 있었고, 편지에는 진짜 보물은 친구와 함께한 모험이라고 쓰여 있었어요. 두 친구는 그 말이 맞다고 생각해서 웃었어요.
There was no gold, only a letter, and it said the real treasure was the adventure they shared. They laughed because they knew it was true.

ends: Leo and Dana write their own riddle and hide it for other kids.
레오와 다나가 직접 수수께끼를 만들어 다른 아이들을 위해 숨겨요.
A new bottle washes up with a map to a small island.
작은 섬으로 가는 지도가 든 새 병이 바닷가로 떠밀려 와요.

write.src: “I think <u>the real treasure is friendship</u> because <u>Leo and Dana had fun together</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because they solved it together)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because they solved it together)

img.cover: In a sunny old town square, a boy with curly brown hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts points up and shouts at a big old clock with a round white face, two black hands, and dots instead of numbers on a tall stone tower, while a girl with two long red braids in a green striped dress holds an old green bottle and looks up in surprise, and pigeons fly away from the ringing bell.

scenes.1: On a sandy beach with gentle waves, a girl with two long red braids in a green striped dress and a boy with curly brown hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts sit next to an old green bottle and a rolled-up yellow paper and scratch their heads, with thought bubbles above them showing a silly green monster and a boxy silver robot.
scenes.3: Inside a dusty clock tower full of big turning gears, a boy with curly brown hair in a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts and a girl with two long red braids in a green striped dress kneel and open a small wooden box that holds only a folded paper, and both of them are laughing.
